```plato
    //==
    // # Polyline length and deformation
    //
    // The length and deformation bodies for the chains declared in
    // `polygons.types.plato`. The `Closed` flag decides whether the wrap-around edge
    // counts; the underlying `ChainLength` kernel is in `geometry.library.plato`.

    //==
    // # Polylines

    // The summed length of the chain; the wrap-around edge counts only when Closed.
    Length(p: Polyline2D): Number
        => p.Points.ChainLength(p.Closed);
```

## Line 310

**Source:** [stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato, line 310](../../../../../stdlib/geometry/polygons.library.plato#L310).

```plato

    // The summed length of the chain in N dimensions. Written out rather than
    // delegated because ChainLength is spelled for Point2D/Point3D only; PointN's
    // delta type is VectorN, whose Magnitude comes from INormed.
    Length(p: PolylineN): Number
        => SumOf((p.Closed ? p.Points.Count : p.Points.Count - 1)
            .MapRange(i => p.Points[i].Between(p.Points.AtModulo(i + 1)).Magnitude));
```
